reproducibility.description: The matrix generation is deterministic for a fixed seed and the same program implementation. Dense and sparse programs use separate pseudo-random number generators, so their generated matrices are not guaranteed to be identical.

dense.generation: The C program generates two reproducible matrices A and B. Values are pseudo-random multiples of 0.001 between -1.000 and 1.000.

sparse.generation: The C program uses its own deterministic xorshift-style pseudo-random number generator, initialized with seed 123456789. Matrix A is generated using the requested zero percentage, with nonzero candidate values drawn from multiples of 0.001 between -1.000 and 1.000. Matrix B is generated pseudo-randomly using the same generator state.
